purpose: Public and official source registry for Volkswagen Group DSG / Audi S tronic software update, mechatronic, basic settings, and diagnostic routing.
legal_boundary: Store durable routing notes and source URLs only. Do not copy OEM manuals, paid erWin/Elsa content, flash files, ODIS datasets, SVM action files, or forum procedures into the knowledge base.

sources.notes: Use as an official SVM route reference; still verify each repair by VIN in the current OEM service system.
